Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class TcpServer

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Server
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.TcpServer
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, Runnable
    public class TcpServer
extends Server
implements Runnable
    Provides a TCP server that accepts incoming socket connections and creates TcpClient instances for connected clients.

    Each accepted connection is represented by a server-side TcpClient, allowing the connection to use the standard KDC TCP client communication facilities. Connected clients are maintained in the server's Hub.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    Server, TcpClient, TcpServerParameters

      • run

        public void run()
        Runs the TCP server and accepts incoming client connections.

        This method starts the connection queue, creates the server socket, and listens for incoming connections while the server is running. Each accepted socket is added to the connection queue for creation and initialization of a server-side TcpClient.

        The connection queue is stopped when the server terminates.

        Specified by:
        run in interface Runnable
        Specified by:
        run in class Server

      • handleConnection

        public void handleConnection​(Socket socket)
        Creates and starts a server-side TcpClient for an accepted socket.

        The client is configured using this server's communication settings and registered with the server's Hub. This allows the accepted connection to use the standard KDC TCP client communication facilities.

        Parameters:
        socket - the socket for the accepted client connection

      • halt

        public void halt()
        Halts all clients connected to this TCP server and then stops the server.

        If the server is already being halted, this method has no effect.

        Overrides:
        halt in class Server

      • stop

        public void stop()
        Stops this TCP server and closes its server socket.

        The server is marked as no longer running, its thread is interrupted, and the server socket is closed. This releases the server thread if it is waiting for a connection or for space in the connection queue.

        The method waits for the server thread to terminate.

        Overrides:
        stop in class Server
